APARTMENT LEASE AGREEMENT
Brightwater Flats, 2650 SW 34th Street, Gainesville, Florida 32608

Fill in each blank. Check one box where a choice is given. A box that is not checked does not apply.

1. PARTIES AND UNIT
Owner: Brightwater Flats Owner, LP ("Landlord"), managed by Coastal Realty Partners, LLC ("Manager").

Resident: Morgan Patel ("Tenant").

Apartment: Unit 214, Building 2, Brightwater Flats, 2650 SW 34th Street, Gainesville, Florida 32608.

2. TERM
Lease begins: August 15, 2026. Lease ends: August 14, 2027.

[X] The lease ends on the date above.   [ ] The lease renews month to month unless either party gives notice.

3. RENT
Monthly rent: $975.00, due on the 1st day of each month.

Pay rent: [X] through the resident portal at brightwaterflats.example/pay   [ ] by check at the leasing office   [ ] by money order only

4. LATE CHARGES
[X] If rent is not received by 11:59 p.m. on the 4th day of the month, Tenant will pay an initial late charge of $75.00 and a daily late charge of $10.00 per day after that, but total late charges for one month will not be more than $175.00.

[ ] No late charge applies.

Returned payment charge: $50.00.

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT AND FEES
Security deposit: $500.00.  Non-refundable administrative fee: $150.00.

The security deposit is held by Manager: [ ] in a separate interest-bearing account   [X] in a separate non-interest-bearing account   [ ] by a surety bond. Name of bank: Florida Credit Union, 4220 NW 16th Boulevard, Gainesville, Florida 32605.

6. UTILITIES
Tenant pays: [X] electricity   [ ] water and sewer   [ ] trash   [X] internet and cable
Landlord pays: [ ] electricity   [X] water and sewer   [X] trash   [ ] internet and cable
Tenant must start electric service in Tenant's name before move-in.

7. OCCUPANTS AND GUESTS
Only Tenant may live in the apartment. A guest may not stay more than 7 nights in any 30-day period without Manager's written approval.

Brightwater Flats Apartment Lease   Page 1 of 3

8. PETS

[ ] Pets are allowed under a separate Pet Agreement. [X] No pets are allowed. This includes visiting
pets.
Assistance animals are not pets. Tenant may ask Manager for a reasonable accommodation for an
assistance animal at any time.

9. PARKING
Parking spaces: 1. Parking permit fee: $0.00. Vehicles without a permit sticker may be towed at
the owner's expense.

10. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
Tenant must ask for repairs: [X] by submitting a request through the resident portal [ ] in writing
delivered to the leasing office [ ] by phone only
For an emergency (fire, flood, gas smell, no heat in winter, or no air conditioning when it is over 85
degrees inside), call the 24-hour emergency line at (352) 555-0160 and also submit a portal
request.
Manager will make repairs within a reasonable time. Tenant pays for repairs caused by Tenant,
Tenant's guests, or misuse, other than normal wear and tear.

11. ENTRY BY MANAGER
Manager may enter the apartment to inspect, repair, or show it, after giving Tenant at least 24
hours' notice by email or by a notice posted on the door, between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Manager
may enter at any time without notice in an emergency.

12. SMOKING
[X] This is a non-smoking apartment. No smoking or vaping inside the apartment, on balconies, or
within 25 feet of any building. [ ] Smoking is allowed on the balcony only.
A smoking violation is a breach of this lease, and Tenant pays any cost of removing smoke odor.

13. RENTER'S INSURANCE
[X] Tenant must carry renter's insurance with at least $100,000 of personal liability coverage and
must give Manager proof of coverage before move-in. [ ] Renter's insurance is not required.

14. NOTICES
Written notices to Landlord must be delivered to: Coastal Realty Partners, LLC, Brightwater Flats
Leasing Office, 2650 SW 34th Street, Suite 100, Gainesville, Florida 32608.
Delivery: [X] by hand to the leasing office [X] by certified mail [X] by email to
leasing@brightwaterflats.example [ ] email is not allowed for notices.
Notices to Tenant may be delivered to the apartment or sent by email to the address Tenant gave in
the rental application.

15. MOVING OUT

Brightwater Flats Apartment Lease Page 2 of 3

Tenant must give written notice of moving out at least 30 days before the lease ends. If Tenant does not give this notice and moves out on the end date, Tenant owes one month's rent ($975.00) as liquidated damages.

Tenant should give Manager a forwarding address in writing before moving out.

16. EARLY TERMINATION

[ ] Tenant may end this lease early by giving 60 days' written notice and paying an early termination fee of $____. [X] This lease does not include an early termination option. If Tenant moves out early, Tenant is responsible for rent as Florida law provides.

17. SUBLETTING

[X] Tenant may not sublet or assign this lease. [ ] Tenant may sublet with Manager's written approval.

18. SIGNATURES

Tenant: ___________________________ Morgan Patel Date: July 30, 2026

Manager, for Landlord: ___________________________ Coastal Realty Partners, LLC Date: July 30, 2026

Brightwater Flats Apartment Lease Page 3 of 3
